deliberate_trade_offs: Executes strictly Jira-internal rules (issue create/update/transition triggers, scheduled JQL sweeps, field conditions, subtask/linked-issue branches, field edits, comments, transitions) and explicitly refuses outbound Slack/Teams/third-party webhooks — trading external integrations to maintain the pure zero-egress 'Runs on Atlassian' trust badge and instant IT security approval.

Provides zero Groovy/JavaScript scripting engine and zero UI field-behaviour hooks — deliberately leaving custom code and screen logic to ScriptRunner, Scriptwright, and Forgappify Field Rules so non-coding Jira Standard admins can offload rules via 1-click native JSON import without maintaining code.

Uses Atlassian's standard per-user Marketplace tiers (100% self-serve, no enterprise SOWs, no custom SLAs, no Data Center build) — deliberately forfeiting 5,000-seat enterprise deals to keep 0% Marketplace rev share up to $1M lifetime Forge revenue and near-zero sales overhead.
indie_feasibility: Buildable in 6-8 weeks by a 1-2 person technical indie team on Atlassian Forge (Node.js/TypeScript + Forge Triggers, Scheduled Triggers, KVS, and Custom UI). Unit economics leverage a structural Forge arbitrage: Atlassian provides 200,000 GB-sec/mo free compute then $0.000025/GB-sec (~$1.25 per 1M 200ms invocations) versus $0.50/1,000 native Jira Automation steps, while Atlassian charges 0% Marketplace rev share up to $1M lifetime Forge revenue and handles all invoicing, taxes, and 30-day free trials. Support burden stays low because JSON import validation flags unsupported third-party webhook steps before activation. [UNVETTED] Founder-fit assumptions: assumes founder is comfortable navigating Atlassian Forge manifest limits (7,000 invocations/min/install), Jira REST API v3 rate limits, and Marketplace App Security review.

needs_stack_sketch.alternatives_above: Upgrade the entire organization to Jira Cloud Premium (+$9.90/user/mo = +$11,880-$29,700/yr at 100-250 seats), absorb recurring $0.50/1,000 step overage invoices, rewrite rules from scratch in ScriptRunner/JMWE/JSU ($4,000-$8,000+/yr), or run self-hosted Python/GitHub Actions REST scripts that break zero-egress data residency.
needs_stack_sketch.obviated_below: Auditing exported Automation JSON files manually in spreadsheets, collapsing clean rules into unreadable nested If/Else monoliths, hosting external cron/webhook servers, and passing third-party vendor security questionnaires.
needs_stack_sketch.promise_one_up: Keep every cross-project Jira Standard workflow running continuously without triggering $0.50/1,000 step overage bills, surprise mid-month automation lockouts, or a $12k-$30k/yr forced Jira Premium upgrade.
needs_stack_sketch.your_level: Import high-burn native Jira Automation JSON rules in one click and run those Jira-internal triggers, branches, and scheduled JQL sweeps inside a zero-egress Forge app at zero native automation steps.

one_liner: A pure 'Runs on Atlassian' Forge app that imports high-burn native Jira Automation JSON rules and executes Jira-internal triggers, branches, and scheduled JQL sweeps at zero native automation steps — eliminating default-on $0.50/1k step overages and the +$11,880/yr Jira Premium upgrade wall.
price: $1.50/user/month standard Atlassian Marketplace tiers (free <=10 users; $900/yr at 50 seats; $1,800/yr at 100 seats; $4,500/yr at 250 seats; ~17% annual billing discount; 30-day free trial via Paid via Atlassian).
specific_buyer: Jira Cloud Standard Administrators and IT Operations Leads at 50-250 seat organizations ($5,820-$29,100/yr base Jira Standard spend) hitting Atlassian's pooled 400 steps/user/month Automation Usage-Based Pricing cap with active overage bills or halted workflow rules.
specific_problem: Atlassian's 2025-2026 step-based Automation Usage-Based Pricing counts every trigger, condition, branch, loop iteration, and NO_ACTIONS_PERFORMED evaluation against Jira Standard's 400 steps/user/mo pool, enabling $0.50/1,000 step overages by default (or halting all rules completely if opted out). Upgrading to Jira Premium adds +$9.90/user/mo (+$11,880/yr at 100 seats; +$29,700/yr at 250 seats). Live Marketplace audit confirms existing floors leave a structural gap: native post-functions lack scheduled JQL and cross-project loops; diagnostic apps (Automation Usage & Risk Analyzer, Step Cost Analyzer) only read JSON without executing rules; low-cost Forge utilities handle cron issue creation only (Recurring Work, Workflow Scheduler) or require manual JavaScript coding (Scriptwright); and legacy enterprise suites (ScriptRunner $4k-$8k+/yr, JMWE $4.5k-$5k/yr, JSU $5k-$5.75k/yr, JWT) force full manual rule rewrites at enterprise ACVs. No verified pure Forge app imports native Jira Automation JSON to execute Jira-internal high-burn rules directly at zero native steps.
title: StepShield for Jira (Forge Automation JSON Offload Runner)

deliberate_trade_offs: Uses zero proprietary Confluence content macros — parsing native Atlassian Document Format (ADF) headings via background Forge page-update events instead of wrapping text in custom macros — trading inline body badges so native Confluence PDF exports and Rovo indexing never break and customers face zero lock-in.

Refuses to build whole-page ISO/FDA multi-stage approval workflows, e-signatures, or PDF watermarking — deliberately ceding formal document-publishing governance to Comala, Seal Docs, Breeze, and Midori to stay hyper-focused on sub-page section freshness and Rovo context hygiene inside living runbooks.

Runs 100% deterministic ADF section hashing and quarantine rules inside Atlassian Forge with zero external LLM API calls — trading generative AI auto-rewriting for the 'Runs on Atlassian' zero-egress trust badge and zero extra Rovo Credit burn.
indie_feasibility: Buildable in 6-8 weeks by a 1-2 person technical indie team using Atlassian Forge (Confluence `avi:confluence:updated:page` triggers, Confluence REST API v2 ADF body fetch, Forge KVS/Custom Entities for section hashes and ownership maps, Confluence Content Byline + Space Page UI Kit/Custom UI). Non-invasive read-only onboarding lets an admin scan an entire 500-page engineering space in minutes during the 30-day Marketplace free trial without editing a single page. Atlassian handles billing, tax, and 0% Marketplace rev share up to $1M lifetime Forge revenue. [UNVETTED] Founder-fit assumptions: assumes founder can engineer resilient ADF heading-matching heuristics across heading renames/reorders and stay within Forge KVS storage and compute allowances.

needs_stack_sketch.alternatives_above: Upgrade Confluence Standard to Premium (+$2,742-$8,340/yr for 50-100 seats, still page-level only), buy Atlassian Guard Premium (~$12.90/user/mo with Guard Standard) for sensitive-data controls, pay CodeTailor AI Readiness ($2.99/user/mo = $3,588/yr at 100 seats) or Midori Better Content Archiving (~$2.09/user/mo) for page-level scoring, or manually split monolithic runbooks into dozens of child pages stitched via Include Page macros that break on native PDF export.
needs_stack_sketch.obviated_below: Splitting monolithic runbooks into fragile child-page fragments, maintaining brittle scheduled Confluence Automation CQL loops (`{{pagesPerOwner}}`), manually auditing page histories to see which paragraph actually changed, and warning teams on Slack not to trust Rovo Chat answers.
needs_stack_sketch.promise_one_up: Trust Rovo AI answers and incident runbooks across engineering and IT spaces by catching every stale paragraph hidden inside active documents and isolating unverified pages before Rovo quotes them.
needs_stack_sketch.your_level: Track per-heading content hashes and per-section owners automatically across monolithic Confluence pages without proprietary macros, enable one-click section verification without resetting sibling clocks, and one-click quarantine Rovo-contaminating pages into a restricted holding space.

one_liner: A macro-free 'Runs on Atlassian' Forge app that hashes individual H2/H3 sections inside monolithic Confluence runbooks and SOPs to enforce per-section ownership, prevent typo edits from hiding 18-month-stale paragraphs, and one-click quarantine Rovo-contaminating pages.
price: $2.00/user/month standard Atlassian Marketplace tiers (free <=10 users; $1,200/yr at 50 seats; $2,400/yr at 100 seats; $5,400/yr at 250 seats with Marketplace band tapering; 30-day free trial via Paid via Atlassian).
specific_buyer: Confluence Cloud Administrators, Engineering/SRE Operations Leads, and Knowledge Managers at 50-250 seat organizations ($3,100-$42,300/yr Confluence Standard or Premium spend) maintaining multi-team runbooks and SOPs who enabled Atlassian Rovo AI or migrated legacy Data Center wikis into Cloud.
specific_problem: Confluence Cloud natively tracks `lastModified` and Page Owner strictly at the whole-page level. Fixing one typo or editing a single paragraph resets the timestamp for an entire 15-section runbook or SOP, masking 12-24 month stale sections from CQL sweeps and every page-level hygiene app. Because Atlassian Rovo AI semantically ingests every page a user can view (with no native `no-ai-index` toggle and $0.01/credit pooled Rovo overages), Rovo confidently quotes outdated sections inside recently touched pages, while Synchrony drafts lack native Page History rollback before `Ask Rovo` rewrites. Live Marketplace audit confirms page-level hygiene is crowded (Midori Better Content Archiving ~$2.09/u/mo, CodeTailor AI Readiness $1.79-$2.99/u/mo, Forge Doc Ownership & Reviews, Evergreen, Page Hygiene Report), whereas zero verified Forge apps perform macro-free ADF heading/section-level content hashing, per-section ownership verification, and one-click Rovo quarantine isolation with pre-edit snapshots.
title: SectionGuard for Confluence (Macro-Free Section Freshness & Rovo Quarantine)

Targets strictly ISO 9001 Clause 7.5 and ISO 27001 A.5.1 controlled-document lifecycles and version-locked Teams read attestations — deliberately excluding CAPA, calibration, supplier audits, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 biometric e-signatures, and custom consulting implementations so buyers deploy self-serve in under 30 minutes.

Ships strictly opinionated Draft -> Review/Approve -> Read-Only Published -> Obsolete Archive state transitions on SharePoint Online libraries — trading arbitrary Power Platform/NITRO workflow canvas builders for zero-maintenance upgrades that never break when an admin leaves the company.
indie_feasibility: Buildable in 8-10 weeks by a 1-2 person technical indie team as a Microsoft Teams app (Teams Tab + Adaptive Card Bot for version-locked read acknowledgments) paired with an SPFx SharePoint library extension and a thin stateless license-verification endpoint wired to Microsoft's AppSource SaaS Fulfillment API. Microsoft commercial marketplace handles 1-click self-serve billing directly on the buyer's existing M365 invoice/MACC at a 3% commission fee. Zero external storage of customer documents eliminates cloud hosting COGS and removes SOC 2 / enterprise DPA blockers (DP10/DP22). [UNVETTED] Founder-fit assumptions: assumes founder can navigate Microsoft Partner Center transactable Teams SaaS certification, Entra ID SSO, Microsoft Graph permissions, and SharePoint Online permission-inheritance automation.
